title: Joiz tests the UBS customer service-via online chat
description: Anonymous online or personal advice: How do you do it with your bank? We tried the various UBS customer service options: http://www.joiz.ch/ubskundendienst   Joiz can be received in Swiss free TV via cable and satellite, in the live stream on www.joiz.ch and here on YouTube. You can chat, check in, coordinate, to collect bathrooms and points for interactions at any time and to drop cool products.  More information on: http://www.joiz.ch  joiz @ Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/JoizTV joiz @ Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/joiztv Joiz @ Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/joiztv joiz @ Google+: http://plus.google.com/+joiz/posts

asr.full_text: HOW LONG DO WE HAVE TO SIGN IN? How long should it take until someone responds? In case I'm pressing chat start button? It goes very fast. Actually, you should be able to respond within minutes. Really? Ah, I'm excited. Press the button, pay attention! Chat start! Good day. Welcome at UBS How can I help you? And simply toss? That's the rule, right? Yes, of course. Are we on the same page and I'll do it. It works already, right? Yes, surely. So... are we... per... do... Seres and myself do do it but I prefer the sit on it. So Mr. Ackermann is in? I... will give up over the next week And for the more interesting things to come this week, follow me to Kuala Lumpur! I am going to Kuala Lumpur over the weekend. So how can I buy Malaysian currency? You can use our service line at the number [PHONE] to order could order the foreign currency using our service line number 08488 48042. Will it also be available to me on time then? The fixed-net fee rates apply, in two to three working days, the money would be available to you or you can have it delivered to a UBS to apply for a job at a business or institution. A good approach. At the moment, I would like to take time-consuming vacations with Iva. And I can get time-consuming vacations with Iva as well if that is what you want. Yes. I have a question, sure. And my question is, I'm getting married to my girlfriend and we need a joint Account, can you open one for me? It even says no, you are the girlfriend, they do not hope. So she answered. I would like to invite you to a personal consultation, in one of our branches. Could you give me an appointment now? I work at Örlikon, a day off is good. I'd love to tell you, that there is a customer consultant available at the desired time at midday. Is that alright for you Mr Ackermann? Thank you. In order for the customer consultant to prepare himself better for the conversation, I Ackermann. Thanks. To better introduce the customer consultant to our discussion I need some information Can you please give me the name of your friend and tell me where she lives? My future girlfriend will hopefully be Ewa ... and from Herzli. That always fits in your chat. OK, now we'll see how she answers She says, We want to offer our customers a timely communication platform I personally find this communication channel very exciting and handy. That moved me. My heart's back, actually. I agree with her. Thank you, Iwa.

visual.observation: A chat window labeled "UBS Chat" states that a UBS employee will assist the user, while the conversation discusses opening a joint account and directs the user toward a UBS branch or customer adviser.
visual.context: The visible exchange is presented as a customer-support conversation about a banking-account question; whether it is an authentic UBS channel or a demonstration is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed bank-support identity is linked to an account-opening inquiry and suggested contact with a branch or adviser, creating a task-relevant identity-and-destination relationship for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the chat's authenticity, whether any account was opened, whether the user followed the suggested contact route, or whether any loss occurred.

visual.observation: Within the UBS-labeled chat, the interlocutor asks for additional information, including the user's friend's name and place of residence, after discussing preparation for a customer-adviser conversation; the exchange also visibly references providing a telephone number as an example.
visual.context: The request appears in the same visible banking-support conversation and is framed as information needed to prepare an adviser discussion.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed bank-support channel requests personal information in connection with a promised or expected banking consultation, which is a concrete identity-and-data-request relationship.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not show whether the information was submitted, whether the chat was official, or how the information would be used.

visual_context_notes.observation: The chat interface visibly includes the label "Nutzungsbedingungen" and directs the user toward a UBS branch or customer adviser in parts of the exchange.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Joiz testing UBS customer-service options and the speed of its online chat. The interaction concerns ordinary banking questions, including foreign currency and a joint-account inquiry, with referral to a branch consultation. Requests for the friend's name and residence appear within the customer-support test rather than as the video's own deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content context is an examination of customer service: the title calls it a test, the speaker initiates the chat, asks ordinary banking questions, and arranges or discusses a branch consultation. The evidence does not establish that the creator is promoting a scam.
